title: 🗠💥Psychology of the American Nightmare in The Great Gatsby

sentences.en: Hi, this is Joel, and you're listening to the Taproot Therapy Collective podcast, and today
sentences.zh: 嗨，我是乔尔，欢迎收听“主根疗法集体”播客，今天

sentences.en: I'm reading an article from our blog called The Anima of the Great Gatsby and the Animus of History.
sentences.zh: 我将朗读我们博客上的一篇文章，题为《伟大盖茨比的阿尼玛与历史的阿尼姆斯》。y

sentences.en: Cultures wax and wane, empires that seem like part of the cosmos themselves, fall like a gunshot victim into a pool, or lines on a bar chart.
sentences.zh: 文化兴衰交替，那些看似永恒不朽的帝国，最终也会像水中的中枪者或条形图上的线条一样轰然倒塌。

sentences.en: It is the rare work that can speak to both the sparkle of the spectacle, and the timeless inevitable reel that it distracts us from.
sentences.zh: 能够同时道出奇观的闪耀以及我们为之分心的永恒不可避免之命运的作品，实在是凤毛麟角。

sentences.en: The Great Gatsby was an immediate success, and then forgotten, and then rediscovered.
sentences.zh: 《了不起的盖茨比》出版后轰动一时，随后被人遗忘，接着又被重新发现。

sentences.en: It was forgotten because the jazz age was a beautiful, maybe, but still nearsighted dalliance.
sentences.zh: 它之所以被遗忘，是因为爵士时代是一场美丽却短视的短暂欢愉。

sentences.en: Fitzgerald was lumped in with all of the other out-of-date, out-of-style gauche-ness that the book was mistaken as a celebration of.
sentences.zh: 菲茨杰拉德被与所有那些过时、不合潮流的粗俗之物混为一谈，这本书也被误认为是对此类事物的赞歌。

sentences.en: It was rediscovered because critics realized that the book was like one of those sweet-scented
sentences.zh: 它之所以被重新发现，是因为评论家们意识到，这本书就像那些散发着甜美气息的

sentences.en: breakup notes that is written so beautifully that the dumped sod misreads it as a love letter and puts it with the other love notes unawares.
sentences.zh: 分手信，由于写得实在太美，被抛弃的笨蛋误把它当成了情书，稀里糊涂地把它和其他情书收在了一起。

sentences.en: The Great Gatsby was a warning, and you can only hear the warning after the fall.
sentences.zh: 《了不起的盖茨比》是一个警示，而你只有在浩劫过后才能听懂这个警示。

sentences.en: Perhaps half love letter and half kiss-off, some part of Fitzgerald knew that his world was ending.
sentences.zh: 或许它半封情书，半封诀别信，菲茨杰拉德内心深处隐约感觉到他的世界正在走向终结。

sentences.en: The jazz age was the parados, or the fun act of the ancient Greek tragedy where characters
sentences.zh: 爵士时代就像是古希腊悲剧中的序歌或喜剧插曲，剧中的角色

sentences.en: expound humorously against the chorus on the character faults that will later undo them against the grinding, unwinding of time.
sentences.zh: 在歌队面前幽默地大发议论，谈论那些最终会毁掉他们的性格缺陷，任凭时间的齿轮无情地研磨、流逝。

sentences.en: Ancient Greece and Rome looked the same in the periphery and quite different in focus.
sentences.zh: 古希腊和古罗马在边缘上看起来相似，但在核心上却大相径庭。

sentences.en: Greeks sought to be ideal through archetype, where Romans sought reality through realism.
sentences.zh: 希腊人通过原型追求理想，而罗马人通过现实主义追求现实。

sentences.en: Greece, like F.
sentences.zh: 希腊，正如F.

sentences.en: Scott Fitzgerald, dealt in the realm of the anima, the passive, intuitive, and emotional aspect of the psyche.
sentences.zh: ·斯科特·菲茨杰拉德一样，探讨的是阿尼玛的领域，即心灵中被动、直觉和情感的一面。

sentences.en: They were comfortable with beauty through vulnerability and had a poetic culture that celebrated poetic introspection.
sentences.zh: 他们安于通过脆弱展现美，并拥有一个崇尚诗意内省的诗歌文化。

sentences.en: The Greeks were fascinated with the introspective world of the psyche and their ability to express complex emotions and ideas through symbolic and mythological language.
sentences.zh: 希腊人对心灵的内省世界着迷，并热衷于通过象征和神话语言来表达复杂的名言和思想。

sentences.en: To them, archetypes were like platonic forms or perfect ideals removed from time.
sentences.zh: 对他们而言，原型就像是柏拉图式的形式或超越时间的绝对理想。

sentences.en: A common bit of conventional wisdom is that Greeks made their gods into men and
sentences.zh: 一种常见的传统观点认为，希腊人把神塑造为人类，而

sentences.en: Romans made their men into gods.
sentences.zh: 罗马人把人类塑造为神。

sentences.en: When you look at Greek sculpture, there is this perfect quality where all blemishes are stripped away.
sentences.zh: 当你欣赏希腊雕塑时，会发现有一种完美的特质，所有的瑕疵都被剥离了。

sentences.en: It is the perfect ideal or archetype of the man.
sentences.zh: 这就是人类完美的理想或原型。

sentences.en: Roman masculinity, Roman beauty celebrated the ugliness, the realistic, the more masculine part of self, you know, the animus.
sentences.zh: 罗马的阳刚之气、罗马的美崇尚丑陋、现实、自我中更为阳刚的部分，也就是阿尼姆斯。

sentences.en: You know, Rome, like Fitzgerald's contemporary Ernest Hemingway, was more closely
sentences.zh: 你知道的，罗马，就像菲茨杰拉德的同时代人欧内斯特·海明威一样，与

sentences.en: associated with the qualities of the animus, the masculine, assertive, and imperialistic aspect of the
sentences.zh: 阿尼姆斯的特质紧密相连，即心灵中阳刚、自信和帝国主义的一面，

sentences.en: psyche, the ego expanding quality, not ego dissolving, introspecting quality like the anima.
sentences.zh: 这种特质会扩张自我，而不是像阿尼玛那样解构自我、进行内省。

sentences.en: Roman culture was characterized by its emphasis on law, order, and external appearances of military might.
sentences.zh: 罗马文化的特点是对法律、秩序以及军事力量外在表象的强调。

sentences.en: It gave rise to some of the most impressive feats of engineering, architecture, and political organization in the ancient world.
sentences.zh: 它催生了古代世界中最令人瞩目的工程、建筑和政治组织成就。

sentences.en: The Romans were known for their practicality, their discipline, and their ability to translate ideas into concrete realities.
sentences.zh: 罗马人以务实、纪律严明以及将想法转化为具体现实的能力而闻名。

sentences.en: To Rome, the aspirational and ideological only mattered in hindsight.
sentences.zh: 对罗马而言，追求崇高和意识形态只有在事后才具有意义。

sentences.en: To a Greek, one noticed the archetype or one failed to.
sentences.zh: 对希腊人来说，人们要么注意到了原型，要么就没有。

sentences.en: To a Roman, one created the archetype.
sentences.zh: 对罗马人来说，原型是人创造的。

sentences.en: Humans made things real or we didn't.
sentences.zh: 人类让事物成为现实，否则就一事无成。

sentences.en: Romans got credit for ideas in a way that Greeks didn't.
sentences.zh: 罗马人因思想而获得赞誉，而希腊人则没有这种待遇。

sentences.en: To a Greek, we were glimpsing the inevitable realm of the possible through cognition.
sentences.zh: 在希腊人看来，我们是通过认知在惊鸿一瞥可能性的必然领域。

sentences.en: Time was cyclical.
sentences.zh: 时间是循环的。

sentences.en: Ideas were external.
sentences.zh: 思想是外在于人的。

sentences.en: You didn't have ideas, they just had you for a minute.
sentences.zh: 你没有产生思想，只是思想暂时借用了你。

sentences.en: For Romans, a man came up with the idea and deserved credit.
sentences.zh: 而对罗马人来说，某个人想出了一个点子，就应当记上一功。

sentences.en: This is an interesting dichotomy because both ideas are true, but paradoxical ways of studying the way that we think.
sentences.zh: 这是一个有趣的二分法，因为这两种观点都是正确的，却又是研究我们思维方式的悖论路径。

sentences.en: Something like object relations.
sentences.zh: 类似于客体关系理论。

sentences.en: There are different sides of that argument or different sides of that dichotomy.
sentences.zh: 这场辩论或这种二分法存在着不同的侧面。

sentences.en: All of the early modernist writers, you know, Fitzgerald's time, they engaged with this dialect differently.
sentences.zh: 所有的早期现代主义作家，也就是菲茨杰拉德那个时代的人，都以不同的方式参与了这种辩证。

sentences.en: Fitzgerald leaned
sentences.zh: 菲茨杰拉德偏向

sentences.en: Greek animistic.
sentences.zh: 希腊式的阿尼玛。

sentences.en: Hemingway leaned into the Roman animus.
sentences.zh: 海明威则倾向于罗马式的阿尼姆斯。

sentences.en: And other contemporaries like Gertrude Stein tried to bridge the divide and integrate both of these kind of psychic forces.
sentences.zh: 而像格特鲁德·斯泰因这样的其他同代人则试图弥合这一鸿沟，将这两种心理力量融合在一起。

sentences.en: There was no way around, as literature progressed, confronting that expression of what the self was.
sentences.zh: 随着文学的发展，无可避免地要直面这种对自我的表达。

sentences.en: Greece and Rome were also deeply interconnected and mutually influential.
sentences.zh: 希腊和罗马也深度互联、相互影响。

sentences.en: Greek art, literature, and philosophy had a profound impact on Roman culture and many Romans saw themselves as the heirs and stewards of the Greek intellectual tradition.
sentences.zh: 希腊的艺术、文学和哲学对罗马文化产生了深远影响，许多罗马人将自己视为希腊知识传统的继承者和守护者。

sentences.en: At the same time, Roman law, government, and military power provided a framework for the spread and preservation of Greek ideas through the Mediterranean world.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，罗马的法律、政府和军事力量为希腊思想在地中海世界的传播和保存提供了框架。

sentences.en: We need both the anima and the animus to be the whole self, effective at wrestling the present and possible together if we are to be effective at acting on the impending real.
sentences.zh: 要想成为一个完整的自我，能够将现实与可能性捏合在一起，从而有力地作用于迫在眉睫的现实，我们就必须同时拥有阿尼玛和阿尼姆斯。

sentences.en: The intuition of the anima can let us see the future through dreams of creativity and visions for the possible, but the animus is what
sentences.zh: 阿尼玛的直觉能让我们通过创造力的梦想和对可能性的愿景预见未来，但阿尼姆斯才是

sentences.en: lets us bring our agency to bear on the present moment.
sentences.zh: 让我们把主观能动性施加于当下的力量。

sentences.en: It is easy to hide in either one, but when you do, you miss the both.
sentences.zh: 人们很容易躲进这两者之一，但一旦你这么做，就会两边皆失。

sentences.en: I read The Great Gatsby in high school, and it was one of the few assigned readings that I didn't hate.
sentences.zh: 我读高中时读过《了不起的盖茨比》，这是少数几本我不讨厌的指定阅读书目之一。

sentences.en: I wanted to read Michael Crichton and classical mythology primary sources, but the curriculum wanted me to slog through things like Nathaniel Hawthorne and Zora Neale Hurston.
sentences.zh: 我想读迈克尔·克莱顿的作品和古典神话一手文献，但教学大纲却要我硬啃内森iel·霍桑和佐拉·尼尔·赫斯顿的书。

sentences.en: I enjoyed the points that those authors made criticizing Puritanism and celebrating African-American folk culture
sentences.zh: 我分别很欣赏这些作家批判清教主义和歌颂非裔美国人民间文化的观点，

sentences.en: respectively, but I thought that the stylism made reading them a slog.
sentences.zh: 但我认为其文风让阅读过程成了一种苦差事。

sentences.en: The Great Gatsby was simple, and I have reflected on it over the course of my life.
sentences.zh: 《了不起的盖茨比》很简明，我在人生的各个阶段都对它进行了反思。

sentences.en: Luckily, if you're trying to read a book in the early 2000s that they don't want you to have in school, they made these things called cargo pants
sentences.zh: 幸运的是，如果你在2000年代初想读一本学校禁止你看的书，当时发明了一种叫工装裤的东西，

sentences.en: that fit a 500-page Wheel of Time novel perfectly.
sentences.zh: 它装下一部500页的《时光之轮》小说刚刚好。

sentences.en: In high school, I saw Hemingway and Fitzgerald as two halves of the same coin.
sentences.zh: 在高中时，我认为海明威和菲茨杰拉德是一枚硬币的两面。

sentences.en: Fitzgerald was the nostalgic reflective anima to Hemingway's masculine animus.
sentences.zh: 菲茨杰拉德是海明威充满阳刚之气的阿尼姆斯的充满怀旧反思色彩的阿尼玛。

sentences.en: Hemingway jumped headlong into the morphine promises of modernism, and Fitzgerald seemed to reflect on
sentences.zh: 海明威一头扎进现代主义许下的吗啡诺言中，而在我看来，菲茨杰拉德对

sentences.en: modernity a little bit more honestly to me because he was pulled begrudgingly into it while trying to
sentences.zh: 现代性的反思要真诚一些，因为他是不情愿地被卷入其中，同时却试图

sentences.en: look further and further back into the past and its inevitabilities of illusions of progress.
sentences.zh: 将目光投向更久远的过去，去探究其中关于进步幻想的必然性。

sentences.en: Most of my friends were manly Hemingways who were comfortable in the logos of the accessible reel, and I was a
sentences.zh: 我的大部分朋友都是男子气概十足的海明威式人物，他们安于触手可及的现实的逻各斯，而我则是一个

sentences.en: navel-gazing Fitzgerald who only felt comfortable cloaked in the mythos of intuitive space.
sentences.zh: 沉溺于自我审视的菲茨杰拉德，只有披上直觉空间的神话外衣才会感到自在。

sentences.en: In Jungian psychology, invented by Jungian psychologist Carl Jung, the concepts of anima and animus are crucial for understanding the inner world of the creative.
sentences.zh: 在由荣格学派心理学家卡尔·荣格创立的荣格心理学中，阿尼玛和阿尼姆斯的理念对于理解创作者的内心世界至关重要。

sentences.en: The anima represents the feminine aspects within the male psyche, while the animus represents the masculine aspects within the female psyche.
sentences.zh: 阿尼玛代表男性心灵中的女性特质，而阿尼姆斯代表女性心灵中的男性特质。

sentences.en: A healthy integration of these archetypes is essential for wholeness in the person's personal life, you know, behind the creative works.
sentences.zh: 这些原型的健康整合对于个人生活的完整性至关重要，你知道的，也就是创作作品背后的生活。

sentences.en: As a therapist, I find that those and other
sentences.zh: 作为一名治疗师，我发现这些以及其他

sentences.en: Jungian concepts usefully help me understand why certain people gravitate naturally to different things over the course of their life.
sentences.zh: 荣格概念能够非常有效地帮助我理解为什么某些人在人生的历程中会自然而然地被不同的事物所吸引。

sentences.en: Fitzgerald's life and work were dominated by his anima, which manifested in his nostalgic yearning for the past, his romantic idealization of many, many women, and his
sentences.zh: 菲茨杰拉德的生活和作品由他的阿尼玛主导，这表现在他对过去的怀旧渴望、对众多女性的浪漫理想化，以及他

sentences.en: sensitivity to the nuances of emotion and beauty.
sentences.zh: 对情感和美之细微差别的敏感上。

sentences.en: While these qualities fueled his artistic genius, they also left him vulnerable to depression, addiction, and a sense of alienation from the modern world.
sentences.zh: 虽然这些特质激发了他的艺术天才，但也使他极易受到抑郁、成瘾以及与现代世界产生疏离感的困扰。

sentences.en: It was this alienation from modernism while writing as a modernist that gave Gatsby a timeless predictive quality that Hemingway lacks.
sentences.zh: 正是这种在作为现代主义者写作时却与现代主义产生的疏离感，赋予了《盖茨比》一种海明威所不具备的超越时间的预言特质。

sentences.en: Ultimately, he was able to predict the future as a creative, but unable to adapt to it as a man.
sentences.zh: 归根结底，他作为一名创作者能够预知未来，却作为凡夫俗子无法适应未来。

sentences.en: Hemingway, on the other hand, embodied the over-identified animus, the archetypal masculine energy that values strength, independence, and action.
sentences.zh: 与此相反，海明威体现了过度认同的阿尼姆斯，即崇尚力量、独立和行动的原型男性能量。

sentences.en: Above all else, it is the ego-expanding element of a person that would lead them to do something like create an empire, instead of dissolve
sentences.zh: 最重要的是，它是个人能够做出诸如建立帝国之类的事情，而不是将自己

sentences.en: themselves into the creative flow or fall in love.
sentences.zh: 溶解在创作洪流中或陷入爱河之中的那种自我扩张的元素。

sentences.en: His writing, or to contact the intuition that might let one predict the future in the way that I would argue Fitzgerald did, whether or not he knew it.
sentences.zh: 他的写作，或者说触及那种可能让人以我所认为菲茨杰拉德那种方式预知未来的直觉，无论他是否意识到这一点。

sentences.en: His writing, Hemingway's, celebrated the virtues of courage, stoicism, and physical prowess, and he cultivated a public image as a rugged adventurer of a man of action.
sentences.zh: 海明威的写作赞美了勇气、坚忍和身体力量的美德，他将自己塑造成一个硬汉冒险家和行动派的公众形象。

sentences.en: However, this one-sided embrace of the animus left Hemingway emotionally stunted and unable to deeply connect with others or to find peace within himself.
sentences.zh: 然而，这种对阿尼姆斯的片面拥抱让海明威情感发育受阻，无法与他人产生深层次的情感连接，也无法在内心中找到平静。

sentences.en: Hemingway is all bombastic adventure, and when the adventure is over, there was little left.
sentences.zh: 海明威全是夸夸其谈的冒险，而当冒险结束时，便所剩无几了。

sentences.en: One of their other contemporaries, Hemingway and Fitzgerald's contemporary, Gertrude
sentences.zh: 海明威和菲茨杰拉德的另一位同代人，格特鲁德·

sentences.en: Stein, seems to have been able to achieve a kind of dynamic balance between her masculine and feminine quality.
sentences.zh: 斯泰因，似乎在其男性和女性特质之间实现了一种动态平衡。

sentences.en: This is not to say that she was free from all psychological conflicts or blind spots, but rather
sentences.zh: 这并不是说她没有所有的心理冲突或盲点，而是说

sentences.en: she was able to channel her energies into her work and her relationships in a way that was largely generative, sustainable, and life-affirming.
sentences.zh: 她能够将自己的精力倾注于工作和人际关系中，这种方式在很大程度上是具有创造力、可持续且肯定生命的。

sentences.en: Stein's work and life could be seen as an example of the power of the anima and the animus within the psyche.
sentences.zh: 斯泰因的作品和生活可以被视为心灵中阿尼玛与阿尼姆斯力量的一个例证。

sentences.en: Fitzgerald's own insecurities and traumas contributed significantly to his anima-dominated psyche and artistic worldview.
sentences.zh: 菲茨杰拉德自身的 insecurities（不安全感）和创伤显著地促成了他由阿尼玛主导的心灵和艺术世界观。

sentences.en: Fitzgerald remained haunted throughout his life.
sentences.zh: 菲茨杰拉德一生都饱受心魔萦绕。

sentences.en: Had he lived long enough to encounter Carl Jung's work, Fitzgerald would likely have been profoundly influenced by it.
sentences.zh: 如果他能活得足够久去接触卡尔·荣格的著作，菲茨杰拉德很可能会深受其影响。

sentences.en: Jay Gatsby seems to be the Jungian archetype of the puer eternus or eternal boy, frozen by an impossible to attain object of desire and following a refusal to grow up.
sentences.zh: 杰伊·盖茨比似乎是永恒少年这一荣格原型的化身，他因一个无法企及的渴望对象而停滞不前，并拒绝长大。

sentences.en: A charming, appealing, affecting, but ultimately failed visionary chasing red herrings or mirages.
sentences.zh: 一个迷人、动人、感人，但最终却归于失败的空想家，在追逐红鲱鱼或海市蜃楼。

sentences.en: Fitzgerald himself seemed to go down the same path as other male Jungians, most notably
sentences.zh: 菲茨杰拉德本人似乎也走上了与其他男性荣格主义者相同的道路，最典型的就是

sentences.en: James Hillman and Robert Moore, failing to fully ride the animus and integrate their assertive energies to manifest changes in their personal lives.
sentences.zh: 詹姆斯·希尔曼和罗伯特·摩尔，他们未能完全驾驭阿尼姆斯并整合其自信的能量来在个人生活中实现改变。

sentences.en: All were beautiful artists, but not always beautiful men, especially in their end.
sentences.zh: 他们都是优秀的艺术家，但并不总是优秀的男人，尤其是在他们生命的晚年。

sentences.en: There seems to be a common thread in these anima-over-identified men, a childhood trauma that stifles self-expression, which paradoxically fosters a somewhat magical,
